feeRates.description: Effective spot fee rows ordered by symbol_id ascending. The result is a finite snapshot of the requested or currently listed, non-disabled spot market catalog and is not paginated.

breakdown.description: Components of the effective maker and taker rates in force.

accountDiscounts.description: Account discounts in force on this market, in no particular order. The highest maker discount and the highest taker discount apply, each possibly from a different discount.

allMarkets.description: True when the discount applies to every spot market; false when it applies to selected markets, this one included. A referral discount always applies to every spot market.

effectiveFrom.description: Time from which the discount is in force, inclusive.

effectiveTo.description: Time at which the discount ends, exclusive. Omitted when it has no scheduled end.

makerDiscountPercent.description: Maker fee discount encoded as a base-10 percentage string without a percent sign, with at most two decimals. It lowers a positive maker rate only.

takerDiscountPercent.description: Taker fee discount encoded as a base-10 percentage string without a percent sign, with at most two decimals.

marketMultiplier.description: Fee schedule multipliers in force on this market. Omitted when none is in force, which leaves the tier rates unchanged.

effectiveFrom.description: Time from which the fee schedule is in force, inclusive.

effectiveTo.description: Time at which the fee schedule ends, exclusive. Omitted when it has no scheduled end.

makerMultiplierPercent.description: Maker rate multiplier encoded as a base-10 percentage string without a percent sign, between 0 and 100 inclusive with at most two decimals.

takerMultiplierPercent.description: Taker rate multiplier encoded as a base-10 percentage string without a percent sign, between 0 and 100 inclusive with at most two decimals.

referralDiscount.description: Referral discount in force for the account. Omitted when none is in force.

allMarkets.description: True when the discount applies to every spot market; false when it applies to selected markets, this one included. A referral discount always applies to every spot market.

effectiveFrom.description: Time from which the discount is in force, inclusive.

effectiveTo.description: Time at which the discount ends, exclusive. Omitted when it has no scheduled end.

makerDiscountPercent.description: Maker fee discount encoded as a base-10 percentage string without a percent sign, with at most two decimals. It lowers a positive maker rate only.

takerDiscountPercent.description: Taker fee discount encoded as a base-10 percentage string without a percent sign, with at most two decimals.

tierMakerFeeRatePercent.description: Maker fee rate of the account's VIP tier under the fee policy in force, before the market multiplier and discounts, encoded as a base-10 percentage string without a percent sign. Values are between -100 and 100 inclusive; a negative rate is a rebate.

tierTakerFeeRatePercent.description: Taker fee rate of the account's VIP tier under the fee policy in force, before the market multiplier and discounts, encoded as a non-negative base-10 percentage string without a percent sign, between 0 and 100 inclusive.

makerFeeRatePercent.description: Effective maker fee rate encoded as a base-10 percentage string without a percent sign. Values are between -100 and 100 inclusive. It is computed from breakdown as SpotFeeRateBreakdown describes.

nextChangeAt.description: Earliest scheduled time at which a component of these rates starts or ends: a fee schedule or discount in breakdown ending, or a VIP tier, fee policy, fee schedule or discount not yet in force starting. The effective and reserve rates can change then, or stay the same. Omitted when no change is scheduled.

postOnlyReserveFeeRatePercent.description: Fee rate a new post-only limit order on this market reserves its fee at when the fee is paid in the quote asset, encoded as a non-negative base-10 percentage string without a percent sign, between 0 and 100 inclusive: the highest maker rate of every VIP tier under the fee schedule in force on this market, as reserve_fee_rate_percent describes.

reserveFeeRatePercent.description: Fee rate a new order on this market reserves its fee at when the fee is paid in the quote asset, encoded as a non-negative base-10 percentage string without a percent sign, between 0 and 100 inclusive. It is the highest maker or taker rate of every VIP tier under the fee schedule in force on this market, so it is at least the effective rates and discounts never lower it. A buy limit order that pays its fee in the quote asset reserves N + F, computed in units of 10^-18 of the quote asset whatever the quote asset's own decimals: N is its price times its quantity rounded up to 10^-18, and F is N times this rate rounded up to 10^-18. It has sufficient quote balance when N + F is at most the available quote balance, compared in the same 10^-18 units; other order validation and market limits still apply. A post-only limit order reserves at post_only_reserve_fee_rate_percent instead, and a buy sized by a quote amount reserves at the lower of this rate and taker_fee_rate_percent. Fills charge the effective rate, and the rest of the reserve is released as the order fills or ends.

takerFeeRatePercent.description: Effective taker fee rate encoded as a non-negative base-10 percentage string without a percent sign. Values are between 0 and 100 inclusive. It is computed from breakdown as SpotFeeRateBreakdown describes.

vipTier.description: VIP tier used to resolve these rates, in the inclusive range 0 through 10.

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.
